responsibility: Implements builtin Rust #[derive(PartialEq)] expansion by generating AST impls for both PartialEq and the structural partial-equality marker trait. This file builds an eq(&self, other: &Self) -> bool method from chained fieldwise == comparisons for structs and tuple structs, constructs enum equality as a match over the pair (self, other) with variant-specific destructuring for identifier and tuple variants, and emits unsupported diagnostics for enum struct variants and unions that are not yet handled.
same_name_distinction: Implementation file for PartialEq derivation: it defines the code that builds chained field comparisons and enum match-based equality logic and emits diagnostics for unsupported cases, while rust-derive-partial-eq.h only declares the DerivePartialEq class and helper interfaces.
